**Aggregate total capital returned to common shareholders across the six MI cohort issuers in FY2024 was approximately $3.65 billion.**
- Arch Capital's total was dominated by a one-time $1.9B special dividend ($5.00/share) — its first-ever common dividend — with only $24M in buybacks.
- MGIC was the largest repurchaser at $567M and paid $131M in dividends.
- NMIH returned capital only via buybacks ($98M) as it does not pay a dividend.
